title: Commutativity in a Poincaré-Type Inequality
summary: We study a Poincaré-type inequality for Gaussian measures restricted to origin-symmetric convex sets. The inequality arises from the second variation at $t=0$ of the function $t\longmapsto γ_Σ\left(e^{tA}K\right)$, where $Σ$ and $A$ are symmetric matrices. The relevance of this function comes from Saroglou's reformulation of the log-Brunn--Minkowski conjecture. We show that $Σ$ and $A$ commute if and only if the inequality holds for every box of the form $UD B_\infty^n$, where $U$ is orthogonal and $D$ is diagonal. In the non-commuting case, this yields counterexamples for orthogonal boxes…
